title: Password Reset
text: To reset your password, click Forgot Password on the sign in page and follow the emailed link to choose a new password.

title: Billing and Invoices
text: Invoices are generated monthly and emailed as a PDF. You can download past invoices from the Billing tab in your account settings.

title: Refund Policy
text: Refunds are issued within 14 days of purchase if the product is unused. Contact support with your order number to request a refund.

title: Shipping Times
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and is available at checkout.

title: Account Deletion
text: To delete your account, go to Account Settings and select Delete Account. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

title: Two Factor Authentication
text: Enable two factor authentication in Security Settings to add a one time code from an authenticator app at sign in.

title: API Rate Limits
text: The API allows 100 requests per minute per API key. Exceeding this limit returns a 429 status code until the window resets.

title: Data Export
text: You can export all your data as a CSV file from the Privacy tab. Exports are prepared within 24 hours and emailed to you.

title: Subscription Cancellation
text: To cancel your subscription, open Billing and choose Cancel Plan. Your plan remains active until the end of the billing period.

title: Contact Support Hours
text: Support is available Monday through Friday from 9am to 6pm Eastern Time. Email replies typically arrive within one business day.

title: Change Email Address
text: To change your email address, go to Account Settings, edit your email, and confirm the change using the verification link sent to the new address.

title: Mobile App Installation
text: The mobile app is available for iOS and Android. Search for the app name in the App Store or Google Play and sign in with your existing account.
